root_text:
🚨 Alert: Surge in Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in China causing packed hospitals. Symptoms include cough, fever, and nasal congestion; severe cases can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia. Stay informed and take precautions.

#HMPV #Healt
